description: Post a comment on a recording the user owns, under the user's name: a new comment pinned to timestampMs, or a reply when parentCommentId is given. Everyone in the thread is notified, so show the user the exact text and get their go-ahead first. Needs comments:write.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

parentCommentId.description: Reply to this comment from list_comments.

timestampMs.description: Where in the video the comment points (new comments).

name: add_comment
